  • Method Details

    • id

      public OidcClient.OidcClientBuilder id(String id)
      Client ID.
      Notes:
      • OIDC client IDs must be unique for all RPs within the configuration of each environment (trustbroker-inventories/environment).
      • OIDC client IDs used for CPs may overlap both across CPs and with those of RPs.
      Returns:
      this.
